facts.text: The co-op program alternates paid, full-time work semesters with semesters of classes: at least three work terms with the same employer, and you stay enrolled tuition-free while working. Finishing earns a co-op designation on your diploma.

sources.title: Georgia Tech Catalog: Center for Career Discovery and Development
sources.quote: Co-op designation on the graduation diploma at the completion of the 3 work terms with the same employer

sources.title: Georgia Tech Career Center: Undergraduate Co-op Program

facts.text: Unlike most selective schools, Georgia Tech requires SAT or ACT scores.

sources.title: College Scorecard (test policy Georgia Tech reports)
